description.en: Short answers on packaging, samples, data sheets, OEM, shipping, lead time and inspection.

answer.en: Packaging customization can be discussed. State the pack type you need and your destination in the request form, and we will reply with what can be arranged for your order.
Samples can be requested through the quote form. Name the product family, the grade if one is listed, and your destination.

question.en: Can I get a technical data sheet?

answer.en: Yes, technical data sheets can be requested. Tell us the family and grade you are considering, using the form or by email.

question.en: Do you supply for hydraulic and CNC applications?

answer.en: MICONG lists Anti-wear Hydraulic Oil for hydraulic equipment and cutting fluids for CNC and metal cutting work. Send the equipment and operating details so the right family and grade can be discussed.
OEM cooperation can be discussed. Describe your brand, the product family and your pack requirements in the message field.
Sample shipping is at the customer cost. Include your destination in the request so shipping can be discussed.
Lead time depends on order size and is discussed for each inquiry. Include quantity and destination so timing can be discussed.

question.en: Can a third party inspect the goods?

answer.en: Third-party inspection can be discussed on request. Mention it in your inquiry together with what you want checked.
